informal_claim: There exists a finite unit-distance graph embeddable in ℚ(√2)² that is not 4-colorable, establishing that χ(ℚ(√2)²) ≥ 5.
hypotheses: V is a finite subset of (ℚ[√2])²
E is the set of pairs (u, v) in V × V with exact Euclidean distance squared equal to 1
target: ¬ (∃ c : V → Fin 4, ∀ (u v : V), (u, v) ∈ E → c u ≠ c v)
